title: FlexLine Back-Billing Share by Months Since the Draw
content:
FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit: a draw fee billed after the month of the draw is scaled by a back-billing share. The back-billing share follows the whole calendar months from the draw date to the booking date: two months or more give 0.75; one month gives 0.90; less than one month gives 1.00.

The share multiplies the fee after it has been raised to the tier's minimum draw fee, and the result is rounded to the cent. On a tier whose draw fee percent is above 0.00 the back-billed fee is therefore never 0.00, since it is at least the tier's minimum draw fee times the back-billing share.

| Whole calendar months from the draw date to the booking date | Share |
|---|---|
| two or more | 0.75 |
| one | 0.90 |
| less than one | 1.00 |

Months are counted from the draw date to the booking date, a month counting only once the booking date's day of the month reaches the draw date's day of the month.

*Hypothetical dates and figure:* a draw on 30 April billed on 29 May is 0 months (1.00); billed on 30 May, 1 month (0.90); billed on 30 June, 2 months (0.75). A 5.00 USD minimum fee at 0.75 is 3.75 USD.
